newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Unionamerica Q2 shr down.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Unionamerica Q2 shr down.

text.p: (Dollars in thousands, except for per share data)
Income from operations before income taxes6,462 7,136

(A) On December 31, 1996 the company acquired 51 percent of the ordinary share capital of Jago Dedicated Ltd, which holds 100 percent of the ordinary share capital of Jago Capital Ltd. Aon Specialty Group Ltd has a minority interest in Jago with the balance of interest held by Jago management and staff. Jago is a Lloyd's of London dedicated corporate vehicle and, for 1997, provides about 4 percent of the underwriting capacity for HG Jago & Others, Non Marine Syndicate 205 at Lloyd's. For the first six months of 1997, the investment in Jago contributed $6.6 million to gross premiums written.

(B) Other expenses have increased by $1,041k (14.3 percent) this year; a large proportion is due to the inclusion of foreign exchange losses of $332k and costs arising from the company's investments in Polis Direct (UK) Ltd and Jago Dedicated. Excluding the effect of these, operating expenses have increased by 7.2 percent.

(C) The company completed a refinancing with a group of banks led by the Chase Manhattan Bank on April 29, 1997. Under the refinancing the existing amount of long term debt outstanding of $35 million will bear interest at a margin of 9/16th percent over LIBOR, and repayment will be in full on December 31, 2001. Additionally the revolving facility has been increased from $15 million to $20 million. Upon completion of the refinancing, the deferred financing costs relating to the original loan have now been written off resulting in an extraordinary loss, net of tax, of $267k.

(D) Per share figures are based upon the weighted average number of shares outstanding and the dilutive effect of share options held by management and the over-allotment options granted to the Underwriters in the Public Offering of December 1995, utilizing the treasury stock method and presented to give retroactive effect to the reverse stock split of 1 to 4.48 effective December 4, 1995. The weighted average number of ordinary shares and share equivalents outstanding was 8,838,283 and 8,720,291 for the three month periods ended June 30, 1997 and 1996 respectively, and 8,838,418 and 8,724,552 for the six months ended June 30, 1997 and 1996 respectively.
(E) Net income excluding realized capital gains and losses and extraordinary refinancing costs net of taxes.
